messages.content:
Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"description": "Structured output for statement generation.", "properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements from the answer", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "Which threat groups does MITRE ATT&CK record as using every technique described in Proofpoint's January 2022 report “OiVaVoii – An Active Malicious Hybrid Cloud Threats Campaign”?",
    "answer": "**APT28 (G0007)** is the only threat group in the supplied MITRE ATT&CK facts recorded as using all five *parent techniques* identified in the report: Masquerading, Email Collection, Steal Application Access Token, Adversary-in-the-Middle, and Phishing. Some of its recorded uses are of sub-techniques rather than the parent technique directly. [edge:attack:USES:G0007:T1036] [edge:attack:USES:G0007:T1114.002] [edge:attack:USES:G0007:T1528] [edge:attack:USES:G0007:T1557.004] [edge:attack:USES:G0007:T1566.001]\n\nIf “every technique” includes the report’s named **sub-techniques**, the supplied facts do not establish a group that uses them all: APT28’s cited phishing use is Spearphishing Attachment, while the report names Spearphishing Link. [edge:attack:USES:G0007:T1566.001] [edge:attack:SUBTECHNIQUE_OF:T1566.001:T1566] [edge:text:MENTIONS:proofpoint_2022-01-27_oivavoii-active-malicious-hybrid-cloud#0/m12]"
}
Output:

{
  "statements": [
    "APT28 (G0007) is the only threat group in the supplied MITRE ATT&CK facts recorded as using all five parent techniques identified in the January 2022 Proofpoint report “OiVaVoii – An Active Malicious Hybrid Cloud Threats Campaign”.",
    "The five parent techniques identified in the January 2022 Proofpoint report are Masquerading, Email Collection, Steal Application Access Token, Adversary-in-the-Middle, and Phishing.",
    "The supplied MITRE ATT&CK facts record APT28 as using Masquerading (T1036).",
    "The supplied MITRE ATT&CK facts record APT28 as using an Email Collection sub-technique (T1114.002).",
    "The supplied MITRE ATT&CK facts record APT28 as using Steal Application Access Token (T1528).",
    "The supplied MITRE ATT&CK facts record APT28 as using an Adversary-in-the-Middle sub-technique (T1557.004).",
    "The supplied MITRE ATT&CK facts record APT28 as using Spearphishing Attachment (T1566.001), a Phishing sub-technique.",
    "Several recorded APT28 technique uses concern sub-techniques rather than parent techniques directly.",
    "If “every technique” includes the named sub-techniques in the January 2022 Proofpoint report, the supplied facts do not establish a threat group recorded as using all the named techniques.",
    "The cited phishing use for APT28 is Spearphishing Attachment, whereas the January 2022 Proofpoint report names Spearphishing Link."
  ]
